Third-party notices for the files in this folder (vendor/pdflib/)

pdf-lib.min.js: pdf-lib 1.17.1, copied unmodified from the npm package (dist/pdf-lib.min.js).
  Copyright (c) 2019 Andrew Dillon. MIT License (see LICENSE.md in this folder).
  It bundles:
  - tslib (helpers). Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. Apache License 2.0 (in this version).
  - pako (zlib compression). Copyright (C) 2014-2017 Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn. MIT License; parts are a port of zlib, Copyright (C) 1995-2013 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler, zlib License.
  - @pdf-lib/standard-fonts (font metrics of the 14 standard PDF fonts). MIT License; based on the afm package, Copyright 2015-2018 Christopher Brown, MIT License.
    The metrics come from Adobe's Core 14 AFM files, which Adobe allows to be copied and distributed.
  - @pdf-lib/upng (PNG decoding), from UPNG.js. Copyright (c) 2017 Photopea. MIT License.
  - base64-arraybuffer. Copyright (c) 2012 Niklas von Hertzen. MIT License.
  - Stream decoders (Stream, DecodeStream, Ascii85Stream, AsciiHexStream, LZWStream, RunLengthStream) ported from Mozilla's pdf.js, Copyright 2012 Mozilla Foundation, Apache License 2.0;
    and the flate stream, a port of XPDF's implementation, Copyright 1996-2003 Glyph & Cog, LLC, made available under the Apache License 2.0 through pdf.js.

fontkit.umd.min.js: @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (a fork of fontkit by Devon Govett), copied unmodified from the npm package (dist/fontkit.umd.min.js).
  Copyright (c) 2014 Devon Govett and Andrew Dillon. MIT License (the same text as LICENSE.md, with these names).
  It bundles:
  - restructure, unicode-properties, unicode-trie, tiny-inflate and dfa. Copyright (c) Devon Govett. MIT License.
  - pako (as above). MIT License and zlib License.
  - A WOFF2 (Brotli) decoder, Copyright 2013 Google Inc. Apache License 2.0.
  - base64-js and ieee754 (from the buffer package). Copyright (c) Jameson Little and Feross Aboukhadijeh. MIT License (base64-js) and BSD 3-Clause License (ieee754, Copyright 2008 Fair Oaks Labs, Inc.).
  - events and string_decoder (from Node.js). Copyright Joyent, Inc. and other Node contributors. MIT License.
  - base64-arraybuffer. Copyright (c) 2012 Niklas von Hertzen. MIT License.
  - clone and deep-equal. Copyright (c) Paul Vorbach and James Halliday. MIT License.

pdf-lib-crypt.min.js: @cantoo/pdf-lib 2.11.1 (a fork of pdf-lib that can encrypt), copied unmodified from the npm package (dist/pdf-lib.min.js). Loaded only to put a
  password on a PDF someone downloads. Copyright (c) 2019 Andrew Dillon and the @cantoo/pdf-lib contributors. MIT License (see LICENSE-pdf-lib-crypt.md).
  It bundles, besides what pdf-lib bundles (above):
  - Encryption (RC4, AES, MD5, SHA-2, the PDF security handler) ported from Mozilla's pdf.js. Copyright 2012 Mozilla Foundation. Apache License 2.0.
  - fflate (compression). Copyright (c) 2026 Arjun Barrett (as its licence file states). MIT License.
  - culori (colours), including OKLab code Copyright (c) 2021 Björn Ottosson. MIT License.
  - node-html-better-parser. MIT License.
  - tslib. Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. 0BSD License.
